question: At the 1992 Summer Olympics, ______ became the first woman to carry the flag of India at the opening ceremony of any Olympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shiny Abraham Wilson.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1992, Shiny Wilson became the first woman to carry India's flag at the opening ceremony of the Summer Olympic Games.
 
• She has been a **National Champion in 800 meters.**
 
• She represented India more than **75 times in international competitions.**
 
• She collected a total of **18 gold and two silver medals **from the seven South Asian Federation (SAF).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karnam Malleswari**__

 
 
• In 1994, **she received the Arjuna Award and in 1999, she received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award, India's highest sporting honor, and the civilian Padma Shri award.**
 
• She is the first Indian woman to win a medal at the Olympics in 2000.
